items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Tony Perrini was talking about that yesterday.

ctx.x: That's the one I remember seeing in one of those, but I mean, it wasn't. Dozens of other colored brass bands. This big Italian band was somewhat of a concert and brass band, military band, all combined. They had the classics. Never heard them swing out much because that marsh they would do with either religious media parlor, just playing marching music.
I think they played a few dances, but they couldn't swing. They played everything when life was a march, you know. Tony Perrini was talking about that yesterday.

Yeah, well, they probably played in the Zerkers and Quadrilles and the Lancers, European type dances like you see in those student princess pictures, you know, that dance, and they'll tear it off. Awesome.
